name: Slow Read Wednesdays book club
reader: People who want to get back into reading but don't want to be pushed into daily check-ins
facts: Wednesdays from 19:30 to 21:00 at the community bookshop
¥25 sign-up fee, including a cup of tea
Everyone brings the book they are currently reading
The first 45 minutes are quiet reading, the last 45 minutes are open sharing
Sharing is optional, and nobody has to finish the whole book beforehand
action: Sign up for this week's session on the bookshop's notice page
